parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty members array and all structural_evidence fields are null (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count are all null). The cluster_id does suggest a subset-pair relationship between a Playcut.CodingKeys nested enum and the Playcut type in Shared/Playlist/Sources/Playlist/PlaylistEntry.swift, but a CodingKeys enum being a subset of its enclosing type's fields is the standard Swift Codable pattern and is intentional by design.
